channel: The site, news.ycombinator.com, for every item: one community where any member can reply to any thread.

terms.licence: No licence is named for posts. The Terms of Use reserve Y Combinator's rights in the site's content.

restrictions.says: you agree not to display, distribute, license, perform, publish, reproduce, duplicate, copy, create derivative works from, modify, sell, resell, exploit, transfer or upload for any commercial purposes, any portion of the Site

obtain.how: The search API is open to anyone without an account.

post.text: The node's text field, as the API returns it.
post.url: The site's item address built from the node's id.
post.title: The thread's title, from the root node's title field.
post.handle: The node's author field, the poster's handle on the site.
post.parent_address: The item address of the node's parent_id; the thread's own post has none.
post.reactions: The root node's points field, counted at the response's moment; comments carry none.
